Name: Click Power
What it does: Each tap counts as this many hits

Name: Earnings
What it does: Multiplies the squares you earn from mining a new block

Name: Defense
What it does: Others need this many times the hits to take your blocks

Name: Growth
What it does: How many new map blocks appear when you mine a new block

Name: Factory Speed
What it does: How fast your factories mine, compared with a base player (0.05 = 1/20)

Name: Factory Lifetime
What it does: How long a factory works after you wake it up

Name: Factory Yield
What it does: Squares a factory earns per block it mines, never more than the block's normal pay
